findings.evidence: Lines 30-33 and 39 (`def sturmVariation (p q : K[X]) (x : K)`). In-repo precedent: `TauCeti/Algebra/Polynomial/Eval/Sign.lean:19` uses root `namespace Polynomial` for `sign_eval_map (p : R[X])`; `TauCeti/Algebra/Polynomial/Sturm/GCD.lean:23-25` uses `namespace TauCeti` + `open Polynomial` for lemmas whose first explicit arg is a hypothesis. Grep for `namespace TauCeti` followed by `namespace Polynomial` matches only this file.
findings.fix: Drop `namespace TauCeti`/`end TauCeti` and use root `namespace Polynomial`, remove `open _root_.Polynomial`, and delete the `open TauCeti` sentence from the module docstring (lines 24-25).
findings.issue: `namespace TauCeti` + nested `namespace Polynomial` for the Mathlib type `Polynomial`: every declaration's first explicit argument is `p : K[X]`, so this material belongs in the root `Polynomial` namespace. Symptoms: `open _root_.Polynomial` on line 33 and the docstring on line 25 telling consumers to `open TauCeti` to get `p.sturmVariation`.

findings.evidence: `mathlib/Mathlib/Data/List/SignVariations.lean:47: def signVariations (l : List α) : ℕ`; grep for `signVariation\b` in Mathlib returns no singular declaration. `mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/Sturm/Sequence.lean:19` also writes "numbers of sign variations".
findings.fix: Rename the definition to `sturmVariations` and update every lemma prefix (`sturmVariations_def`, `sturmVariations_zero_left`, …) accordingly.
findings.issue: `sturmVariation` is singular, but it is a count of sign variations wrapping `List.signVariations`, which Mathlib names in the plural throughout; no singular `signVariation` exists in Mathlib. Consumers will guess the plural.

findings.evidence: Lines 67-69 state an equality; the sibling recurrences at lines 77 and 90 are named `sturmVariation_eq_add_of_eval_ne_zero` and `sturmVariation_eq_add_one_of_eval_ne_zero_of_eval_eq_zero`. Naming conventions: "the name of theorem simply describes the conclusion"; `=` is named `eq`.
findings.fix: Rename to `sturmVariation_eq_of_eval_eq_zero` (plus the plural fix above).
findings.issue: `sturmVariation_of_eval_eq_zero` does not describe its conclusion, which is the equality `sturmVariation p q x = sturmVariation q (-p % q) x`; the `_eq_` is missing, inconsistently with the neighbouring step lemmas.

summary: The file nests `namespace Polynomial` inside `namespace TauCeti` although every declaration takes a Mathlib `K[X]` first, so dot notation needs `open TauCeti` and upstreaming needs a rename. The definition is also singular where the Mathlib count it wraps is plural, and one lemma name omits its equality conclusion.
